title_sq: Apartament ne shitje 2+1 tek Univers City
description_sq:
Apartamenti eshte i tipologjise 2+1, me nje siperfaqe totale prej 129m2, nje planimetri perfekte dhe organizim te rregullt, ku hyrja realizohet nepermjet nje korridori shperndares per ne dhomen e ndenjes, 2 dhomat e gjumit , tualeti dhe ballkoni ne trajten e nje verande i orientuar jug lindje.
Objekti ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti eshte ne fazat finale te punimeve, dhe pritet te dorezohet se shpejti.
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1 in Univers City
description_en: The apartment is of the 2+1 typology, with a total area of ​​129m2, a perfect layout and regular organization, where the entrance is made through a distribution corridor to the living room, the 2 bedrooms, the toilet and the balcony in the form of a south-east oriented veranda. The building in which the apartment is located is in the final stages of works, and is expected to be delivered soon. For more information contact!
